clue.text: The person the police will be most anxious to question

definitions.text: The person the police will be most anxious to question

parts.words: The person the police will be most anxious to question
parts.note: a plain description of the leading figure in a criminal inquiry, whom detectives most want to interview

explanation.definitionFit: The prime candidate for having committed a crime is the one detectives most want to interview.

clue.text: Talk of pies, perhaps?

definitions.meaning: a pie is an old word for a magpie, and the noisy rattling call magpies make has this name

explanation.walkthrough: 'pies' suggests pastry, but it is the old name for magpies, whose harsh call is described with the same word as idle talk.
explanation.definitionFit: Idle talk is prattle, and the rattling call of magpies is known by the same word.

clue.text: Worship someone that is at heart peculiarly solid

indicators.note: at heart says the shuffled letters sit in the middle of the abbreviation

parts.note: i.e. is the abbreviation for 'id est', meaning that is

indicators.note: peculiarly means arranged oddly, so the letters of solid are jumbled

explanation.surface: Someone adores a person who is, deep down, oddly steadfast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'someone' is padding: the definition is 'Worship', with 'someone' as its object. 'at heart' and 'peculiarly' are the two indicators.
explanation.definitionFit: To revere or adore someone excessively is to treat them as a god-like figure to be worshipped.

clue.text: One of them is bound to win the trophy

definitions.text: One of them is bound to win the trophy

parts.words: One of them is bound to win the trophy
parts.note: describes the competitors who have reached the deciding match, one of whom must take the cup

explanation.definitionFit: Competitors who reach the last round are those among whom the winner of the cup must be found.

clue.text: A little insult rankles extremely

indicators.note: A little says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Even a small slight can be terribly galling.
explanation.definitionFit: As a prefix or adjective it means beyond the usual, to an extreme degree.

clue.text: Card-game that's a variety of bridge

definitions.meaning: a gambling card game also known as twenty-one or blackjack
a floating bridge supported on boats or hollow drums

explanation.surface: A card game described as one form of bridge, the contract card game.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bridge' suggests the card game, matching 'Card-game', but here it is a structure over water: a floating bridge resting on boats.
explanation.definitionFit: The card game twenty-one has this name, and so does a floating bridge resting on boats or drums.

clue.text: What one needs to operate a mine in California?

indicators.note: in says the word for a mine is placed within the state's abbreviation

parts.note: a pit is a coal mine

explanation.surface: Asking what it takes to run a mining venture in California.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue also reads as a question about funding a mine, which is why it ends with a question mark.
explanation.definitionFit: Money invested in a business is needed before it can trade or run.

clue.text: No work gets done when he takes the class

definitions.text: No work gets done when he takes the class

parts.words: No work gets done when he takes the class
parts.note: describes the teacher in charge of games lessons, where pupils play rather than study

explanation.definitionFit: The school teacher in charge of games runs lessons of play rather than study.

clue.text: Tactical unit excessively absorbed in a project

indicators.note: absorbed in says one word is taken inside the other

parts.note: a plan is a project or scheme
too means excessively, as in too much

explanation.surface: Someone becomes overly engrossed in a piece of work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tactical unit' is a military term: the smallest body of soldiers commanded by a lieutenant.
explanation.definitionFit: A small military body of soldiers, subdivision of a company, is used as a tactical unit.

clue.text: It comes in useful when one wants to secure temporary accommodation

definitions.text: It comes in useful when one wants to secure temporary accommodation

parts.words: It comes in useful when one wants to secure temporary accommodation
parts.note: 'secure' reads as obtaining a place to stay but means fastening down a camping shelter

explanation.walkthrough: 'secure temporary accommodation' sounds like booking a room, but it means pinning a canvas shelter to the ground.
explanation.definitionFit: A stake driven into the ground fastens the guy ropes of a canvas shelter used for camping.

clue.text: German travel organisation that holds an annual festival in Britain

definitions.text: that holds an annual festival in Britain

indicators.note: organisation means arranging, so the letters of the two words are set out afresh

explanation.surface: A German travel company that hosts a yearly festival in Britain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'organisation' rearranges the letters of GERMAN and TRAVEL. The Worcestershire spa town hosts the Malvern Festival, long associated with George Bernard Shaw's plays.
explanation.definitionFit: The Worcestershire spa town is home to the Malvern Festival of drama and music.

clue.text: Action that may call for an alteration to the sentence

definitions.text: Action that may call for an alteration to the sentence

parts.words: Action that may call for an alteration to the sentence
parts.note: 'sentence' looks grammatical but is the judge's penalty, which a fresh hearing in court may change

explanation.walkthrough: 'sentence' suggests grammar, but it is a court's punishment, which a second hearing of the case may overturn.
explanation.definitionFit: A second hearing of a court case may result in the punishment being changed.

clue.text: Devout early Christian primate inwardly lost in confusion

indicators.note: inwardly says the jumbled letters go inside the word for the primate
in confusion means the letters of lost are mixed up

explanation.surface: A pious early believer who is a monkey, privately bewildered.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inwardly' and 'in confusion' are separate indicators: one places, the other shuffles.
explanation.definitionFit: Each of Jesus's twelve chosen followers was a devoted early believer and missionary.

clue.text: Verse specially composed to answer the purpose

indicators.note: specially composed suggests writing anew, so the letters of verse are rearranged

explanation.surface: A poem written for the occasion fulfils its function.
explanation.definitionFit: To be adequate or suitable for a need is to do the job, as in 'that will do'.

clue.text: A fount of small type

parts.note: 'fount' reads as a printer's set of type, but means a source of water, and this one is little

explanation.walkthrough: A fount in printing is a set of type in one style and size, but here fount means a source of water, and 'of small type' means a little one.
explanation.definitionFit: A little natural source of water rising from the ground is a fount of a small kind.

clue.text: Making good a damaged structure or doing nothing about it?

indicators.note: about means around, so the idle word is placed around the little word

parts.note: resting means doing nothing, being idle

explanation.surface: Repairing a ruined building, or else leaving it alone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'it' just refers back to 'or', the thing that 'doing nothing' goes about.
explanation.definitionFit: Repairing a building brings it back to its former condition.

clue.text: A security device found in catalogues for mountaineers

indicators.note: found in says the device sits inside the catalogues

parts.note: a pin is a fastening device, such as a safety pin

explanation.surface: A security gadget is advertised in brochures for climbers.
explanation.walkthrough: The opening A is taken as it stands, ahead of the container.
explanation.definitionFit: Climbers of high peaks are named after the Alps.

clue.text: Piped music of military or funerary character

definitions.text: Piped music of military or funerary character

parts.words: Piped music of military or funerary character
parts.note: 'Piped music' suggests background music in shops, but means music for the Highland bagpipes

explanation.walkthrough: 'Piped music' suggests background music in shops; here it means music for the bagpipes. It is a Scottish form of theme-and-variations for martial or mourning occasions.
explanation.definitionFit: A classical Highland bagpipe composition of theme and variations, often a lament or call to battle.

clue.text: Comparatively spruce French painter?

definitions.meaning: Jean-Marc ... was an 18th-century French portrait painter

explanation.surface: Asking whether a French artist dresses more smartly than others.
explanation.definitionFit: Smarter in dress means more spruce, and the French portraitist Jean-Marc Nattier bore the name.

clue.text: Water-monster from which Timothy draws a conclusion

indicators.note: from which says the monster's name is drawn out of the letters of the next words

explanation.surface: A sea beast from which a man named Timothy reaches a conclusion.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run across the end of Timothy into draws; 'draws a conclusion' hints at taking letters out.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth the many-headed serpent of Lerna was a monster living in the marshes.

clue.text: Offer to continue resistance

definitions.meaning: to hold something out is to offer or extend it
to keep resisting and not give in

explanation.surface: A proposal to keep up the fight.
explanation.definitionFit: To extend something like a hand is to proffer it, and to refuse to surrender is to keep resisting.

clue.text: Not a Rocker indeed now out of fashion?

annotationWithheld.why: Not a Rocker indeed now out of fashion? (7): MOD in DEED, with the single word 'indeed' read as 'in deed', so it is both the container indicator and the fodder DEED; the grammar cannot split one word into two jobs
annotationWithheld.clue: Not a Rocker indeed now out of fashion?

clue.text: Girl who requires a change of habitat

indicators.note: a change of means the letters of the next word are altered in order

explanation.surface: A girl who needs to move to new surroundings.
explanation.definitionFit: A female first name, borne by a woman disciple in Acts.

clue.text: A snug resort in the Tayside region

indicators.note: resort read as re-sort, so the letters are sorted again

explanation.surface: A cosy holiday spot in eastern Scotland.
explanation.walkthrough: 'resort' reads as a holiday spot but means re-sort: rearrange A SNUG. Tayside was a Scottish region, and this district lay in it.
explanation.definitionFit: A historic county and district of eastern Scotland that formed part of the former Tayside region.

clue.text: Goncharov's lying hero

parts.note: 'lying' suggests a liar, but the Russian novelist Ivan Goncharov's title character spends most of the book lying in bed

explanation.walkthrough: 'lying' suggests deceit, but Goncharov's famously idle hero spends most of the novel lying down.
explanation.definitionFit: Ivan Goncharov's 1859 Russian novel is named after its idle title character, who hardly leaves his bed.

clue.text: Go in for modified coverage

indicators.note: modified means changed, so the letters of the three words are reworked

explanation.surface: Sign up for altered insurance cover.
explanation.definitionFit: Material that tops a building is a protective covering over it.

clue.text: Following the correct procedure as the member of a religious fraternity?

definitions.text: as the member of a religious fraternity?
definitions.meaning: a monk or friar belongs to a religious order, so is inside it

explanation.surface: Doing things by the book, like a monk.
explanation.definitionFit: Proper procedure is following the rules, and a monk belongs to a religious body such as the Benedictines.

clue.text: Clearly unable to scan the horizon

definitions.text: Clearly unable to scan the horizon

parts.words: Clearly unable to scan the horizon
parts.note: describes someone who sees near objects well but cannot make out distant ones, and also someone lacking foresight

explanation.definitionFit: Someone with myopia cannot see far, and figuratively a person lacking foresight cannot look ahead.
